title: Fact-sheet layout — The Queensland Legal Directory
request: Lay out a one-page fact-sheet template for The Queensland Legal Directory and produce a preview page using the sample entries provided. Each fact sheet lists the organisation's name, service categories, phone, email, website, and a short 'how they help' paragraph. Accessible and print-friendly: palette #0B3954 on #FEFFFE with #E0A458 highlights, generous line spacing, and no decorative imagery over text. Deliver the template spec and one rendered preview.

entries.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Legal Service (Qld)
entries.how_they_help: Legal advice and representation relating to criminal, civil and family law, including 24-hour police-station representation for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

entries.name: Basic Rights Queensland
entries.how_they_help: Advice and advocacy on Centrelink assistance, disability discrimination and women's workplace issues, plus community legal education and law-reform advocacy.

entries.name: Gold Coast Community Legal Centre
entries.how_they_help: Free generalist legal advice and assistance throughout the Gold Coast region, from Beaudesert to Tweed Heads and north to Pimpama.
